name: A — Navigation latérale compacte
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished, realistic DESKTOP CRM product UI mockup, landscape 1920x1080, crisp legible French UI text. It is a flat front-on application screen, not a photo, not a device on a desk, no browser chrome, no marketing page. This is a proposed interface for an internal consultant CRM named "CRM". Intended feel: the quiet, clean, simple minimalism of Folk CRM, with familiar shadcn-style native-looking fields. Use a consistent restrained light visual system: white canvas, barely gray navigation, charcoal text, thin neutral borders, small soft corners, no gradient, no glass, no dramatic shadows, no illustrations, no big KPI widgets, no marketing decoration, no colored avatars. System sans-serif typography with clear hierarchy and readable text. Very restrained muted colored dots only for pipeline stages. The view is "Pipeline". Navigation contains exactly "Accueil", "Contacts", "Sociétés", "Pipeline", "Relances"; Pipeline selected. A small visible label "Maquette · Données fictives" identifies sample data. A modest page header says "Pipeline" and secondary text "Vos opportunités, étape par étape." A normal primary button "Nouvelle opportunité" is visible. There are exactly five fixed ordered kanban columns: "À qualifier", "Échange en cours", "Proposition envoyée", "Gagnée", "Perdue". A right-side opportunity details panel is OPEN and the kanban remains visible beside it, with no dimmed backdrop. The selected opportunity is "Accompagnement CRM", linked to fictional company "Atelier Exemple" and fictional contact "Camille Martin". Card shows its title, company, "4 800 € HT", and brief notes "Devis envoyé. Attendre le retour du client." Other clearly fictional sample opportunities: "Atelier automatisation" at 1 200 € HT in À qualifier, "Audit des processus" at 2 400 € HT in Échange en cours, "Formation équipe" at 1 800 € HT in Échange en cours, "Mission conseil" at 3 600 € HT in Gagnée. Perdue can be empty with "Aucune opportunité". Do not invent more navigation, custom pipeline settings, email tools, calendar, AI, scores or campaign functions. All money values are merely sample content under the fictitious-data label. Cards have directly editable amount and notes fields: subtly show one amount field in an editing/focus state with a caret, not a save button. Small unobtrusive "Enregistré" feedback elsewhere demonstrates automatic saving when leaving a field. Card drag affordance can be small; never a prominent feature tutorial. The right panel title is "Accompagnement CRM", close X at top; amount, stage selector "Proposition envoyée", and ONE plain editable notes text area are the first-level information. Notes content: "Devis envoyé. Attendre le retour du client." Not a dated notes feed. Below these, lighter secondary content may show "Société" / "Atelier Exemple", "Contact" / "Camille Martin", and a quiet "Prochaine action" link, so they do not compete with amount/stage/notes. No photo since contact photos are undecided. Text should be accurate and not cramped. No Save button for the inline editing. Show a plausible professionally designed screen, all controls at consistent scale. The three design variants share this exact visual language; vary ONLY layout as described next.
COMPOSITION A: At this 1920px landscape width, slim left sidebar approx 175px wide with five labels and small icons, page header above the board area only, right panel approx 360px wide spanning almost full height. The remaining board area exposes all five columns at comfortable equal width, compact cards with title first, company secondary, amount on its own row, and a single-line notes preview. The selected card in Proposition envoyée is calmly outlined. Panel uses compact vertically stacked labeled fields, generous enough for readable notes. Overall this option optimizes seeing the five stages together. Do not print "Option A" inside the app.
approvalScope: Composition et langage visuel ; défauts de génération exclus ; pas une validation globale du CRM
